summary: Integrated UniversalSimulator, WorldBuilder/LifeSimulation data, the Covenant Engine campaign system, complete fantasy and alien race mechanics, quick stat blocks, XP, genetics, and a shared-galaxy campaign scope.
major_changes: Preserved all 130 deity-created parent races across all 22 creator categories.
Preserved all 31 Alien-Folk races and all 14 identity requirements (434 alien identity slots).
Preserved every source full homebrew race stat block intact and added original 5.5e-compatible mechanics to every race and fixed subtype that lacked mechanics.
Added complete playable Alien-Folk stat blocks with species-specific traits, consent safeguards, and galactic language rules.
Converted all 26 DOCX sources from the campaign package into structured JSON; no DOCX files are included.
Added the Universalian galaxy name Vacío l'Abîme Frénétiacré and the spacefaring alien name Zešijómë throughout defaults and shared-universe data.
Configured campaigns to span medieval Universal through interstellar exploration and population anywhere in the shared galaxy without requiring Universal to remain the story center.
Integrated the hybrid XP system, 22 classes, 22 deities, 81 alignment profiles, spells, genetics, covenants, and campaign bridges as canonical JSON data.
